title.zh: 规划（有盖行人连廊授权）公告 2014

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Planning (Covered Pedestrian Linkways Authorisation) Notification 2014 and shall come into operation on 1 December 2014.

heading.en: Conditions of authorisation for covered pedestrian linkways

text.en:
5. The authorisation for carrying out an operation involving the development of land under paragraph 3 shall immediately cease to apply if —
(a)any consent or approval referred to in paragraph 4(a) or (b) lapses, is revoked or, for any other reason, is no longer valid or applicable; or
(b)any other condition of authorisation referred to in paragraph 4 ceases to be complied with.
